name: Rootbound Shrine
introDiscord:
A forgotten shrine has been completely swallowed by roots. Rootbound
Effigies stand among old offerings, their wooden bodies packed with
letters left by travelers asking the forest for guidance.
introTwitch:
A forgotten shrine has been completely swallowed by roots. Rootbound
Effigies stand among old offerings, their wooden bodies packed with
letters left by travelers asking the forest for guidance.

rootbound-shrine-approach.prompt:
Three rootways pass between silent effigies wrapped in old ribbons and
weathered notes.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp hides Star Candies beneath an effigy holding dozens
of tiny folded letters.

One wooden hand points helpfully toward the cache.

right.message:
A Rootbound Effigy turns its head.

Several old letters rustle inside its chest.

Then it steps off the shrine platform.

forward.message:
Restorative sap rests in a ceremonial leaf.

Shizuki left a folded message beside it:

'Dear Forest,

Please provide directions.

Actual directions.

Not philosophical directions.

Thank you.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative sap and Shizuki's unanswered customer-service
request in place.

rootbound-shrine-depths.prompt:
Moonlit fronds surround three shrine corridors where roots grow around
stacks of old traveler letters.

left.message:
An Effigy quietly collects one fallen letter from the floor.

Then it notices you standing beyond the shrine marker.

Apparently letter duty and guard duty overlap.

right.message:
A moss-covered coffer contains Star Candies and a bundle of unopened
notes addressed simply:

'To the Forest.'

forward.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's second letter:

'Dear Forest,

Found destination myself.

Please disregard previous complaint.

Still think signage could improve.'

rootbound-shrine-threshold.prompt:
Towering roots converge around Knot of Old Oaths, where three routes
pass through generations of offerings.

left.message:
A moonblossom pool rests beneath hundreds of tiny prayer ribbons.

Shizuki's contribution reads:

'Wish:
more berries.
better maps.
Glimmer stop stealing pencil.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool and Shizuki's carefully prioritized wishes
undisturbed.

right.message:
A Rootbound Effigy blocks the shrine path.

Its wooden face is featureless.

Someone has drawn a tiny smile on it.

Shizuki.

forward.message:
An offering basket woven directly into the roots contains Star Candies
and one exceptionally shiny pebble.

The pilgrimage pebble tradition continues.

boss-antechamber.name: Knot of Old Oaths
boss-antechamber.prompt: Every Rootbound Effigy turns toward the oldest knot of roots.

bossPromptDiscord:
The old letters throughout the Shrine begin lifting into the current.

Hundreds circle the Knot of Old Oaths as the roots beneath it rise into
the shape of an enormous wooden figure.

Use /yes to approach the Knot or /no to leave the forest's oldest
collection of promises undisturbed.
bossPromptTwitch:
The old letters throughout the Shrine begin lifting into the current.

Hundreds circle the Knot of Old Oaths as the roots beneath it rise into
the shape of an enormous wooden figure.

Use !yes to approach the Knot or !no to leave the forest's oldest
collection of promises undisturbed.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw. The letters settle slowly back among the roots.

boss.revealText:
The oldest roots twist together around a massive carved body.

Greenwood Idol reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Greenwood Idol settles back into the Knot.

One old letter drifts down beside the exit.

It contains no grand prophecy.

Only:

'Please help me find the way home.'

The forest has kept it all this time."
